steps.name: Set up job
Run actions/checkout@v4
Run actions/setup-python@v5
Run python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
Run python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
Run python -X utf8 tools/haf.py archive verify
Run python -X utf8 tools/haf.py scene-build examples/habitat07/reading-garden.json --runs-root runs/ci07 --run garden-001
Run python -X utf8 tools/haf.py scene-verify --runs-root runs/ci07 --run garden-001
Run python -X utf8 tools/haf.py scene-build examples/habitat07/industrial-yard.json --runs-root runs/ci07 --run industry-001
Run python -X utf8 tools/haf.py scene-verify --runs-root runs/ci07 --run industry-001
Run python -X utf8 tools/haf.py build-study --case room06 --runs-root runs/ci07 --run room-001 --seed 1145
Run python -X utf8 tools/haf.py demo --runs-root runs/ci --run demo-001
Run python -X utf8 tools/haf.py verify --runs-root runs/ci --run demo-001
Run python -X utf8 tools/haf.py dispatch examples/workflow06/model-call.json --runs-root runs/ci --parent demo-001
Run python -X utf8 tools/haf.py verify --runs-root runs/ci --run model-001
Run python -X utf8 tools/haf.py build-case --case elizabeth_tower --run ci-clocktower --execute
Post Run actions/setup-python@v5
Post Run actions/checkout@v4
Complete job
